stem.text: Four point charges, each of charge $Q$, are placed on the edge of an insulating disc of radius $r$.
The disc rotates at a rate of $n$ revolutions per unit time.

stem.alt: Circle with four points marked on its edge, each labelled Q, a radius labelled r, and a curved arrow near the top right.

stem.text: What is the equivalent electric current at the edge of the disc?
